faq.title: No need to complicate what can be simple.
faq.lead: A partnership starts with clear expectations. Here are a few answers to make your first contact easier.
faq.scopeQuestion: Do I need to have everything defined?
faq.scopeAnswer: No. We can start by understanding the problem, the current stage and the goals. The scope is defined after that alignment.
faq.existingQuestion: Do you work on existing projects?
faq.existingAnswer: Yes. JFDEV can support application evolution, frontend improvements, integrations and engineering decisions, as needed.
faq.budgetQuestion: How do budget and timeline work?
faq.budgetAnswer: After the first conversation, we assess goals, complexity, priorities and the collaboration format. That way, the proposal presents scope and terms transparently.
faq.globalQuestion: Do you work with clients outside Brazil?
faq.globalAnswer: Yes. JFDEV works on national and international projects, with communication in Portuguese or English.

hero.lead: How JFDEV collects, uses and protects personal data on this site and in the products and projects it builds.

scope.title: 1. Who this policy applies to
scope.p1: This policy covers this website and, in general, the products, apps and systems built by JFDEV, the brand under which José Fontana works as a software engineer.
scope.p2: Some products may have their own policy, shown inside the product. In that case, the specific policy prevails wherever it is more detailed.

roles.title: 2. Own products and client projects
roles.p1: For JFDEV's own products, JFDEV is the data controller: it decides why and how personal data is processed.
roles.p2: For systems built for clients, the client is the controller of its users' data. JFDEV acts as a processor, following the client's instructions, and the client's privacy policy applies.

collected.title: 3. What data we collect
collected.p1: We only collect what each purpose requires:
collected.contact: Data you send when you get in touch, such as your name, email, phone number and message.
collected.account: Account and usage data in the products, such as your login and the information you enter yourself.
collected.technical: Technical data logged by the servers, such as IP address, browser and access date and time, needed for security and operation.
collected.p2: With your permission, this site uses Google Analytics to measure pages visited, device type and approximate location in aggregate. The analytics tag loads only after you accept. This site does not use advertising.

purposes.title: 4. How we use data
purposes.p1: We use personal data to reply to messages, deliver contracted services and run the products, keep things secure and prevent fraud, and meet legal obligations. Each use relies on a legal basis under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD), such as performance of a contract, legitimate interest, legal obligation or consent.
purposes.p2: JFDEV does not sell personal data.

sharing.title: 5. Sharing
sharing.p1: Personal data is only shared with providers needed to run the service, such as hosting, email delivery, payment providers and audience measurement (Google, when you allow it), and with authorities when required by law.
sharing.p2: Some of these providers may store data outside Brazil. In those cases, the transfer follows the safeguards set out in the LGPD.

security.title: 6. Storage and security
security.p1: We apply technical and organizational measures to protect data, such as encrypted connections (HTTPS), least-privilege access control and backups.
security.p2: No system is completely immune to failure. If a relevant security incident occurs, affected people and Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) will be notified, as the law requires.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and local storage
cookies.p1: This site stores your theme preference and your choice about analytics cookies in your browser. If you accept, Google Analytics also sets its own cookies, such as _ga, to count visits. You can change your choice at any time.
cookies.p2: Products may use essential cookies, for example to keep you signed in. If a product starts using non-essential cookies, you will be informed and, where required, asked for consent.

retention.title: 8. How long we keep data
retention.p1: Data is kept only for as long as the purpose it was collected for requires, or as needed to meet legal obligations. After that, it is deleted or anonymized.

rights.title: 9. Your rights
rights.p1: Under the LGPD, you can request at any time:
rights.access: Confirmation that we process your data, and access to it.
rights.correction: Correction of incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data.
rights.deletion: Anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data or data processed unlawfully.
rights.portability: Portability of your data to another provider.
rights.sharing: Information about who your data has been shared with.
rights.consent: Withdrawal of consent, when consent is the basis for processing.
rights.p2: To exercise these rights, use the contact at the end of this page. For client projects, we will forward your request to the responsible controller.

children.title: 10. Children and teenagers
children.p1: JFDEV's products are not aimed at children. If data from children or teenagers is processed, it will be in their best interest and, where required, with a parent or guardian's consent.

changes.title: 11. Changes to this policy
changes.p1: This policy may be updated to reflect changes in the products or in the law. The last update date is shown at the top of the page, and relevant changes will be announced in the products themselves.

contact.title: 12. Contact
contact.p1: Questions, requests or complaints about privacy can be sent by email. You can also contact the ANPD.

consent.label: Cookie preferences
consent.text: We use Google Analytics cookies to understand, in aggregate, how this site is used. They are only enabled if you allow them.
